Phase 1 of 4

Strategy: The Why & Where

1.1 What Problem Are We Solving?

Problem Statement

Business owners and professionals juggle 5-10 tools daily — WhatsApp, invoicing, ad dashboards, trading screens, sprint boards. Critical information gets lost across conversations, meetings, and apps. There is no single assistant that:

  • Listens to your conversations and remembers everything
  • Works across all your business tools with voice commands
  • Keeps your data 100% private (no cloud dependency)
  • Is affordable for Indian SMBs (not $20+/month Western pricing)

1.4 Competitive Feature Heatmap

Competitive Gaps to Exploit
  • No WhatsApp integration — None of the top 5 have native WhatsApp. Massive for India (78% SMBs use WhatsApp)
  • No action execution — All 5 observe and summarize. None actually DO things (send invoices, reply to customers, execute trades)
  • No India features — GST compliance, Hindi voice, INR trading, Indian city services — untouched by global players
  • Privacy vs. proactivity tradeoff — Khoj is private but reactive. Others are proactive but cloud-only. OmniPilot can be both

1.5 Why Will They Switch to Us?

Unfair Advantage
  1. 7-product integration — No competitor connects to your invoicing + ads + WhatsApp CRM + trading + sprint management. OmniPilot does all 7
  2. Local-first privacy — Everything on your Mac/phone. Competitors send audio to cloud. OmniPilot: zero cloud dependency
  3. India-first pricing — Rs 499/month vs $19/month competitors. Built for Indian SMBs, not Silicon Valley
  4. Action, not just memory — "Send invoice to Brand Tusker" actually sends it. "Reply on WhatsApp" actually replies. Not just a note-taker
  5. Existing customer base — BizBot and AdPilot customers are day-1 prospects. Upsell, not cold acquisition

Business Design: How It Works

2.1 Revenue Model & Unit Economics

2.2 Cost Structure & Path to Profitability

Key Insight

Local-first = near-zero infrastructure cost. Unlike competitors who pay $0.01-0.05 per audio minute for cloud STT, OmniPilot processes everything on-device. The primary cost is the dev team, not servers. Breakeven at ~Month 8 with 100 paying users.

Privacy Promise

End-to-end latency under 1 second. All processing happens on your device. No audio, text, or memory data ever touches a cloud server. Your conversations are yours alone.
